main_text.l: יִבָּם Ch. Leviri jus vel officium præstare, Fratris
absque liberis defuncti uxorem ducere.
יִבְמָא, יִבָּם, יִבָּם Ch. Levir, Mariti frater. Fœmin. יִבְמְתָּא,
Glos, Fratria, Uxor fratris mariti.
יִבַּק יִוּבְקָא Ch. Nomen proprium fluvii, Genef.32.
ubi v.24. in Targ. Jonathanis prave legitur ב, יוקבא
& p transpositis.
יִבַר יַבְרוּחִין Ch. Mandragoræ. Hebr. דוּדָאִים.
יִבַשׁ Ch. ܝܒܫ Syr. Aruit, exaruit, arefactus, ex-
siccatus fuit: Pahel יְבַשׁ Arefacere, exsiccare:
Item intransitive, Arescere, exarescere, Genef.8.7.
Ithpah. אִתְיַבַּשׁ Arefactus, exsiccatus fuit. Aphel אוֹבִישׁ
Ch. ܐܝܒܫ Syr. Arefacere, exsiccare. Jac.1.11.
יַבִּישׁ, יַבֵּישׁ Ch. & Syr. Aridus, arescens, siccus. Plural.
יַבִּישִׁין, יַבִּישִׁין. Fœm. יַבְשָׁא Arida: ܝܒܝܫܐ Syr. Idem. M-
atth.12.10. emph. ܝܒܝܫܐ ad Hebr.11.29.
יַבְשְׁתָּא Ch. ܝܒܫܐ Syr. Arida, aridum, siccum, terra
sicca. ܒܝܒܫܐ Per aridam, per terram, id est, terre-
stri, pedestri itinere, Pedibus, pedes, pedites, πεζῇ
Græcè, Matth.14.13. Mar.6.33. Act.20.11.13.
יוּבְשָׁא Ch. Ariditas, siccitas, Judic.6.37.40.
יַגַּר יַגְרָא, יַגּוֹרָא, & יַגַּר Ch. Cumulus, acervus. Plural. יַגְרִין, יַגּוֹרִין, יַגְרֵי: & יַגְרִין.
אִיגַּר Chald. Idem, Jobi 8.17.
אוֹגַּר Idem, Genef.31.46.47. & Deuter.21.1. in Targ.
Jonath.
